rationale: per_param metric tensors default to CPU and are passed to dist.all_reduce; NCCL needs CUDA, so backend silently falls back to gloo with different reduction semantics. Detection reads each tensor's device at the all_reduce call — observable as a runtime hook around the collective. Schema_topo_precond because the rule is conditional on 'this all_reduce being on the NCCL communicator' (precond on backend/topology), not pure cross-rank equality. Category=communication (anti-example 3: root cause is wrong group/backend, not reduction op). Tier exceeds_tier6 because tensor.device per call is not in Tier 0-6 trace schema.
